Inspect the stored parameter extract in the ITGC configuration baseline and compare it to the live settings.
Inspect one post-upgrade comparison of the extract to the security standard.

attributes.attribute: SAP enforces password parameters at every logon
attributes.procedure: Inspect live SAP parameters for 12-character minimum, complexity rules, 90-day expiry and lock after 5 failed attempts. Optionally test one logon.
attributes.evidence: Live SAP parameter settings; system parameter extract

span.text: At every logon, SAP S/4HANA enforces the password parameters: minimum 12 characters, complexity rules, 90-day expiry and account lock after 5 failed attempts

attributes.attribute: Parameter extract stored in ITGC configuration baseline
attributes.procedure: Confirm the extract exists in the baseline, is dated and agrees to the live settings. The complexity rule details are not specified, so compare to the security standard.
attributes.evidence: System parameter extract in ITGC configuration baseline

span.text: The parameter settings are evidenced by a system parameter extract stored in the ITGC configuration baseline

attributes.attribute: IT Security Officer compared settings to standard after each upgrade
attributes.procedure: For each sampled SAP upgrade, inspect evidence that the IT Security Officer compared the extract to the security standard afterwards and resolved differences.
attributes.evidence: Post-upgrade comparison record; SAP upgrade log

span.text: which the IT Security Officer compares to the security standard after every SAP upgrade

scripts.exception_definition: A password parameter in SAP that differs from the stated requirements or the security standard, a missing or outdated baseline extract, or an SAP upgrade with no documented comparison.
